content_list_json.type: block type: image | table | chart | text | equation
content_list_json.img_path: archive relative path to image asset, e.g. images/figure_1.jpg
content_list_json.image_caption: list of strings or string describing the image
content_list_json.table_caption: list of strings or string describing the table
content_list_json.chart_caption: list of strings or string describing the chart
content_list_json.page_idx: 0-based page index, maps to MediaOccurrence.page = page_idx + 1
content_list_json.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1] normalized coordinates in [0, 1000]
content_list_json.text: equation LaTeX / table representation text when present
content_list_json.ocr: ocr text when present; empty string if omitted (no guessing)

markdown_anchor.anchor_start: Character offset in full.md where ![...](img_path) begins
markdown_anchor.anchor_end: Character offset in full.md where ![...](img_path) ends
markdown_anchor.note: Only written when real textual reference evidence exists; width/height must never be used as anchor
